\textbf{(a)} Signed areas: $[0,2]$: $4$; $[2,4]$: $4$; $[4,5]$: $-1$; $[5,7]$: $-\frac14\pi(2)^2=-\pi$.
\[\int_0^7f=\boxed{7-\pi}.\]
\textbf{(b)} $F'(x)=f(x)$, which is positive on $(0,4)$ and negative on $(4,7)$, so $F$ is largest at $x=4$: $F(4)=\boxed{8}$.

\textbf{(c)} $G(x)=-\int_0^{x^2}f$, so $G'(x)=-f(x^2)\cdot2x$ and $G'(1)=-2f(1)=-2(2)=\boxed{-4}$.

\textbf{(d)} The sum is a right Riemann sum on $[0,2]$ with $\Delta x=\frac2n$:
\[\int_0^2(1+f(x))\,dx=2+4=\boxed{6}.\]
